_readme: World of January 1st, 1911 — consumed by game.js's maybeApplyEraOverrides(). Predates every crisis that historically led to WWI: the Agadir Crisis, the Italo-Turkish War, the Xinhai Revolution, and both Balkan Wars haven't happened yet, so this deliberately differs from era_1914.json in exactly the places those events later changed.

entities: new polity codes (or renames of existing codes). name -> countryLookup, color -> map fill, flag -> countryFlagOverrides (local file). AUH/OTT/RUS/DEU/GBR/RAJ/FRA reuse the exact same entities (and flags, where applicable) as era_1914.json, since none of these empires' basic identity changed between 1911 and 1914 — only their territorial extent differs in specific, historically-documented ways (see countryReassignments below). MAR is new here: Morocco is still a nominally independent Sultanate as of Jan 1911, not yet a French protectorate (that's the Agadir Crisis's outcome, per this preset's Simulation Rules).

countryReassignments: keyed by CURRENT EFFECTIVE owner code (so SOML/disputed-territory baseline overrides are honored); every shape owned by the key is reassigned to the value. Differs from era_1914.json in exactly three ways: (1) MAR is NOT reassigned to FRA — Morocco stays its own entity; (2) LBY is reassigned to OTT, not ITA — the Italo-Turkish War (Sept 1911) hasn't happened yet; (3) MKD, XKX, and ALB are reassigned to OTT, not SRB/independent — the Balkan Wars (Oct 1912 - Aug 1913) that historically stripped these from Ottoman control are still over a year away.
regionReassignments: identical to era_1914.json — the Polish partition, Austro-Hungarian Galicia, and Hungarian Transylvania all predate 1911 by well over a century, so nothing here changes.

Known first-pass approximations, deliberately country-level: North Schleswig stays DNK (modern Danish ADM1 regions don't isolate it); PNG entirely GBR (NE quarter was German New Guinea); YEM entirely OTT (Aden was British); CHN keeps modern extent (the Qing Dynasty's collapse is a live Simulation Rules event, not a starting-state territorial change); Pacific micro-territories only where a clean single owner exists. Hejaz (Saudi Arabia's Makkah + Al Madinah regions) IS carved to OTT below, leaving Nejd (the rest of SAU) independent.

Alsace-Lorraine and South Tyrol/Trieste are carved precisely, against world_regions.json's own real ADM2/ADM3-level entries for these countries (France's actual departments Bas-Rhin/Haut-Rhin/Moselle; Italy's actual Trentino/South Tyrol/Trieste provinces, split out from the old Trentino-Alto Adige/Friuli Venezia Giulia region-level blobs — see Scripts/mp1_fetch_adm2_subregions.py).

Eupen-Malmedy (the Kreis Eupen + Kreis Malmedy territory Germany didn't cede to Belgium until the 1919 Treaty of Versailles/1920 transfer) is carved to DEU below, against a real 10-commune sub-region split out of Liege province — see Scripts/mp1_fetch_belgium_subregions.py. Poland does not appear as a country anywhere in this preset: POL is reassigned wholesale to RUS (the Russian partition/'Congress Poland'), with the German partition (Greater Poland/Posen, West/Pomeranian, Kuyavian-Pomeranian, Warmian-Masurian/East Prussia's western fringe, Lower Silesian, Opole, Silesian) carved to DEU and the Austrian partition (Lesser Poland, Subcarpathian — Galicia) carved to AUH below, in regionReassignments.POL.

Name-only entity overrides added for four countries that otherwise show their modern country_lookup.json name, which is anachronistic at this date: CHN -> 'Qing Empire' (the dynasty still rules as of Jan 1911; its collapse is the live Xinhai Revolution Simulation Rules event, not a starting-state change — territory is unchanged, still full modern CHN extent per the approximation noted above); IRN -> 'Persia' (renamed Iran in 1935); SAU -> 'Emirate of Nejd' (matches the existing Hejaz-carved-to-OTT design above; the unified Kingdom of Saudi Arabia wasn't proclaimed until 1932); THA -> 'Siam' (renamed Thailand in June 1939).

Two countryReassignments additions: PRK (North Korea) was missing its own reassignment to JPN even though KOR already had one — Japan's 1910 annexation covered the whole peninsula, both modern successor codes. MNG (Mongolia) now reassigns to CHN — Outer Mongolia's autonomy declaration was Dec 29 1911, so on this preset's Jan 1 1911 start date it was still nominally Qing territory (matches this same file's own Simulation Rules text describing Mongolian/Tannu Uriankhai independence as a live, not-yet-happened event); left untouched for era_1914.json onward, where that autonomy (recognized by Russia and China via the 1913 declaration/1915 Kyakhta agreement) was already an established fact.

2026-08-24 correction: world_regions.json's USA region id 3363 was named "Marshall Islands" but its 12 shapeIDs are actually ordinary US ADM2 counties all named "Marshall" (Marshall County exists in a dozen states) -- a name-matching bug from whatever built that region grouping, not the real Pacific nation. Reassigning it to DEU/JPN here scattered small DEU/JPN-colored patches across the Midwest, all still mislabeled "Marshall Islands" on hover. The id 3363 entry has been removed from world_regions.json entirely (root fix); this preset's own "3363" regionReassignments.USA entry is removed to match, and clearShapeIDs backfills the correction onto any save that already applied the old regionDataVersion 1. The Northern Mariana Islands entry (id 3097, Rota + Tinian -- real islands, real 1914 German possession) was unaffected and is untouched. The real Marshall Islands aren't represented anywhere in this ADM2 dataset at all (no Pacific-atoll geometry exists for them here) -- don't reintroduce a "3363" reference expecting it to mean them.
